notes:
Share images no longer consume the outbound-link budget.

Docket HEAD-checks a sample of a site's outbound links, capped so that auditing
a large site does not turn into thousands of requests to other people's servers.
The og:image pass that runs first had no cap of its own, so on a site where every
page carries a different share image it used the whole allowance before a single
outbound link was looked at.

On one large site that meant 686 requests against a documented 60, and exactly
one real outbound link checked.

Each now has its own budget, and a dead share image is reported once — as a
share image — instead of also being counted as a broken link in the page copy.
